description:
How AI models (ChatGPT, Gemini, AI Overviews, AI Mode) answer the tracked buyer prompts. Sampled daily: judge windows, not single days.
view:
- summary(days?): Presence, citations, recommendations and sentiment, per AI model, top cited sources and rivals. Lead with unbranded (intentSplit): branded prompts only reach people who know the brand.
- gaps: Last week's gaps: prompts where rivals are named and the brand isn't, each planned, covered or offpage.
- gap_candidates(limit?): The prompts answers left the brand out of over 14 days, worst first: the rivals named instead and whether a page can win it (onpage) or third-party pages decide (offpage).
- competitors: The tracked rivals, past ones, and alsoNamed: brands the answers keep naming that nobody tracks. domainCheck suspect = the saved domain looks wrong.
- sources(days?): The domains and pages AI answers cite, with their owner and page type, against the window before: where answers are built from.
- mentions(days?, engines?, sentiments?, cited?, recommended?, limit?): Answers that named the brand unasked (prompts naming it left out, as in the headline), newest first: the prompt, AI model, sentence, place, sentiment, cited pages.
- rival_pages(days?, competitorId?): Pages tracked rivals added, changed or took down, read from their sitemaps every Monday (7 days when not given).
name: get_visibility
title: Get AI visibility
